g.text: RAW/Identity uses raw uncertainty in both roles; simple scalar methods enter calibration replay unless registered otherwise.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #24323d

g.text: Calibration and acquisition mappings are separable.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #5d6a73

g.text: Matched-beta controls alter exploration pressure without asserting improved probabilistic calibration.

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #5d6a73

g.text: Acquisition-only and joint variants can share an L4 trajectory while retaining distinct L1 evaluations.
